Affrancian Uplands: The green hills of the Uplands are home to some of the most major South Affrancian cities, including its capital; the harbor-city of Délaen.
Carnae: Between the mountains and the desert, the territory of Carnae is all that remains from the once-powerful Suhaman Empiurate.
Lunedale: These valleys host the most major cities of the state of North Affrancia, including the cradle of Affrancian civilization, Avinon.
March of Auverne: Rolling hills and fertile land surround the city of Auverne, a major economic centre of South Affrancia.
Vense: A state at the western edge of the Avar desert, Vense's cities and settlements shine bright as jewels among the sandy dunes.
Damlére: At northernmost edges of the Avar desert lies Damlére - an ancient land of aqueducts and mighty sandstone fortresses.
Free Cities: Economic hub of North Affrancia, this glittering coast is populated by the most talented craftsmen and merchants.
Orlais: The marshlands of Orlais are the natural barrier between the Subavarian lands and the historical region of Affrancia.
Cualus: Bronze coasts of Cualus have always been a secluded haven of sailors and pirates.
Orhas: This inhospitable region between the marshlands and the desert has for the longest time been a gathering place for mercenaries.
Linan: The coastal area of Linan is a major trading route between the north and south of the Subavarian lands.
Vianaa: Jungles and gorges cover much of the area of Vianaa, making this perilous region a natural barrier against attackers.
Osana: This region and its capital, shielded from all sides by the treacherous lands of Vianaa, has become a hidden jewel of the east.
Lamacia: This wetlands region is the former heartland of the Fahlaan Empiurate, the largest empire of the continent.
Fahlaan Dunes: These sandy dunes have for the longest time been a hiding place of Fahlaan strike groups across the rest of the desert.
Leimarch: The single road through the desert, built by marshal Michel Lei, is a treacherous path across the endless sands.
Aunon: Despite being across a mountainside from a desert, the lands of Aunon are the most fertile lands in Subavarian region.
Sordia: This militant kingdom is the economic powerhouse of the south and one of the last bastions of the ancient Kerunian culture.
The Comet: Called the land of merchants, the Comet is a famous hub of traders and mercenaries that are willing to do anything for pay.
Anodia: Largely covered by desert, the lands of Anodia, though poor, are an important cultural crossroads of the region.
Liadnon: This desert state has been torn apart by civil wars more times than any other land on the continent.
Ahtep: This prosperous and militaristic empiurate was once the heart of a mighty empire - now diminished, but nonetheless powerful.
Daomea: The lands of Daomea are the gateway to the savage region of Nordia.
Aelatania: Former territory of the vast Aelatanic Empire, the rolling hills of Aelatania are full of natural wonder and rushing streams.
Ahara: This coastal Nordian country has been an unwilling participant of many regional wars due to their proximity to major regional powers.
Ajuna: Settled between the mountains of Nordia, this region is a place of mining and stonecraft.
Amennia: This empiurate is an important economic power and a major trade hub, owing to its green pastures and vast fields of corn and rice.
Amorian Shores: Seat of the Quil'enian capital Kel'amor, these lands are bustling with activity and trade.
Cinto: Historically a neutral Nordian state, Cinto's political will has been tried and tested in many wars.
Conda: The primary defender of Nordian independence in recent wars, Conda's political elite has never given up on an idea of its regional dominance.
Courtieux: The royal heartland of Azincourne, Courtieux hosts the nation's capital of Meladar and multiple important harbor and trade hubs.
Duchy of Daurels: Tucked among the peaks of the mountains, the Duchy of Daurels has always been a formidable cultural and military region.
Elland: Historical homeland of the Elletic tribes, this grassy region is now marked by many years of religious peace.
Elletian Isles: Off the coast of Elland, these islands host some of Elletia's most powerful strongholds and harbors.
Espoia: This region covers a major trade route between the lands around the Avar desert and Nordian lands.
Lentria: A culturally diverse region of Elletian kingdom, this land is often referred to as the Heart of the South.
Leuse Valley: In valleys around the river Leuse, many of the most powerful and significant cities of Naragonthid find their place.
Lobardia: Historical heartland of the Lobard empire, these vast grasslands and forests offer amazing agricultural potential.
Londia: Bearing name of the Londic Empire, this coastal region is full of ancient wonders and mighty fortresses that stood the test of time.
Mose: A small Nordian region, primarily associated with mining of the most valuable material on the continent - Liquifium.
Nefrid: A naval powerhouse of Nordia, people of Nefrid find themselves often at odds with their neighbors, who do not appreciate their expansive demeanor.
Nordica: Mountains and wetlands cover much of this region of Naragonthid, providing an excellent defense of the western frontier.
Northern Heilonia: Although formally not belonging to Heilonia since the ages past, this region remembers their Heilonic roots and presents them proudly in their mother kingdom.
Northern Quil'en: Divided amongst many city-states, this region is a place of constant change.
Odatria: This central region of Nordia is filled with mountains and marshes - and ruined villages, owing to their central position on the peninsula.
Oucine: The last state of Nordia that remained loyal to the Zjoal Empire, the country nowadays bears much cultural resemblance to their original Empire.
Riar: Located in the center of major Liquifium-mining belt, this country is full of mines and the industry to support them.
Role: Contrary to many Nordian countries, this region is primarily covered in fields, allowing effective agriculture.
Révia: Historically neutral, this small kingdom is a haven for merchants, traders and others interested in coin.
Southern Quil'en: Centered around Tel'abin, this region is a historical rival to Kel'amor and their surroundings.
Sstep: Nested among the tallest mountains on the continent, this country is a major metalworking hub.
The Holy Land: Hosting the holy city of Neimer, the Holy Land is the residence of the Divine Mother.
Valeonia: The northeastern region of Naragonthid is the richest of them all, owing to their agricultural and economic prowess and military strength.
Velognia: Covering long beaches of southern Naragonthid, Velognia is abundant in wealth due to its place as a major trading hub.
Venexia: Historic centre of the Heilonic civilization, Venexia pursues military neutrality and political stability above all.
Vice: Northernmost of the Liquifium-mining countries, Vice combines the expertise of the south with the cultural advancements of the north.
Zjoal Islands: Seat of the ancient Zjoal Emperors, these islands have since those times disintegrated due to plague and disease.
